title: Wolf — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Wolf.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The Science of Cooking." Luxury tier. Wolf has been making commercial cooking equipment since the 1930s and brought that expertise to residential in 2000 when Sub-Zero acquired the brand. Every Wolf range features dual VertiCross convection and dual-stacked sealed burners that simmer at 300 BTU and sear at 20,000 BTU. The infrared charbroiler and griddle options let home cooks replicate restaurant techniques. Wolf is the cooking half of the Sub-Zero Group trifecta.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Serious home cooks, kitchen renovations where cooking is the centerpiece, spec homes where Wolf is the expected standard.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Wolf:

• Dual-stacked burners go from 300 BTU simmer to 20,000 BTU — no competitor matches this range

• Dual VertiCross convection uses two fans alternating direction for even heat everywhere in the cavity

• Infrared charbroiler option lets you grill steaks indoors like a steakhouse

• Red knobs are the most recognized brand symbol in luxury cooking

• Pairs with Sub-Zero fridge and Cove dishwasher for a complete factory-matched kitchen
